protocol: Three stages in every arm; same output caps, actual tokens/cost reported separately. No learned Alien scorer used.

cases.problem: Improve a small classifier on sklearn.load_digits (1797 handwritten8x8 digit images) under label-preserving corruptions: additive pixel noise and random pixel dropout. Use fixed stratified train/validation/test split, fit preprocessing on train only, reserve test for final evaluation, and compare a standardized RBF-SVM plus ordinary corruption augmentation. Optimize mean accuracy across clean and fixed corruption severities under 5 CPU minutes on an Apple Silicon laptop, no pretrained models or external data. Propose a distinct implementable intervention and ablation; do not merely list known techniques or claim external novelty.

Improve a tabular binary classifier when deployment features become missing more often than training features. Use a reproducible synthetic sklearn.make_classification dataset (5000 rows,20 features,5 informative,5 redundant, class balance80/20), a fixed stratified train/validation/test split, and train-only transformations. Predictors may see missingness masks but never test labels during development. Compare median imputation plus HistGradientBoostingClassifier and missingness augmentation. Optimize held-out average precision across clean and predefined missingness stress conditions under 5 CPU minutes on an Apple Silicon laptop. Propose a distinct implementable intervention, not just tuning or ensembling named algorithms. No claim of external novelty without evidence.
